topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I was wandering through the hall, my steps light, when I noticed the notices—like silent whispers on the walls, each one spelling out the change. The building, they said, is turning into condos. I paused, letting the words settle into the spaces between the walls, between the rooms I’ve known for years. I thought about the mornings over countless cups of coffee, the shared smiles in the elevator, the way the sunset now would cast its golden hues into different corners. It’s a new chapter, a fresh turn, and yet, the building’s heart remains, steady and familiar, like a warm embrace. We’ll adjust, the walls and I, and maybe, in the new light, find new stories to tell.
